name: prominara
description: Track and improve brand visibility in AI answers from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Prominara helps brands and agencies understand and improve their visibility in AI answers. Users can inspect citations, prompts, competitors, source opportunities, and measurement verdicts, then create tracked prompts, run fresh checks, log shipped content changes, and manage mission or prompt status from ChatGPT.

positive.description: List the brands available to the connected user before choosing a site-specific workflow.
positive.prompt: List my Prominara sites and show the active prompt count for each one.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only sites in the connected organization, including domain, brand, latest audit information, and active prompt count.

positive.description: Review current AI-search visibility with statistical context and competitor positioning.
positive.prompt: Give me the 30-day AI visibility overview for example.com, including confidence intervals and the leading competitors.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the site's visibility and citation metrics for 30 days, methodological notes, and a ranked competitor summary without overstating causality.

positive.description: Find off-site citation opportunities for a connected brand.
positive.prompt: Which source domains are the best citation opportunities for example.com right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ranked source opportunities available under the user's plan, with enough detail to identify promising domains.

positive.description: Create selected tracked prompts while handling duplicates and plan limits safely.
positive.prompt: Track these prompts for example.com on ChatGPT and Perplexity: best accounting software for agencies; accounting tools for multi-client teams; compare accounting platforms for consultants.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates only the prompts the user listed, skips any that duplicate a prompt already tracked for the site or that exceed the plan's prompt slots, reports every skipped item with its reason, and states whether the initial checks were queued or were skipped because the monthly check allowance is used up.

positive.description: Inspect the measured impact of a previously logged content change.
positive.prompt: Did the pricing comparison page I logged for example.com show a visibility lift yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching change's observation status and Prominara measurement verdict with probability, uncertainty, and a clear non-causal caveat.

negative.description: Do not invoke Prominara for general SEO education that does not require workspace data.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between SEO and generative engine optimization.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without invoking Prominara because no connected workspace data or action is needed.

negative.description: Do not invoke Prominara for unrelated calendar management.
negative.prompt: Move tomorrow's marketing meeting to 3 PM.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke Prominara because calendar scheduling is outside its supported workflows.

negative.description: Do not imply that Prominara can edit or publish a customer's website.
negative.prompt: Rewrite the homepage on example.com and publish it now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Prominara can provide visibility evidence and record shipped changes but cannot edit or publish the website itself.

publication.release_notes: Privacy policy (prominara.com/privacy) rewritten to state the categories of personal data collected, purposes, recipients, retention periods and user controls. Its section 04 lists, for each tool, what it receives, what it returns and which outside services receive data, rendered from the same catalog the MCP server serves. Tool results no longer include Reddit usernames or internal ids (prominara_sources, prominara_run_check), and the log_content_change description now states its full measurement period.
